title: WS2812B strip piece, behind a window
summary: A cut piece of WS2812B (NeoPixel) strip drops into a slot 5 mm back from the wall, LEDs facing out. A front plate holds it upright and the gap spreads the light. The wall gets an open window, a thin diffuser skin printed in the wall, or a hole for a light pipe. Any strip width and LED pitch, one LED or several, standing up or lying along the wall.

views.label: Up and along
views.caption: Left: one LED on a 15 long piece standing up behind an open window, as in the controller base. Right: three LEDs on a piece lying along the wall behind a 0.6 diffuser skin. Drag the slider to lift the pieces out of their slots; turn it round to see the windows.

views.label: Fit piece
views.caption: Four holders for the 10 mm, 100/m strip on one strip of 2.4 wall, marked with 1 to 4 engraved dots: two slot clearances behind open windows, and two diffuser skins.

specs.title: The strip
specs.note: Cut on the pads between LEDs: a piece of n LEDs is n pitches long.

checks: Does the piece drop in and stand upright without rattling?
Can you pull it out by its top edge?
Light it: is the LED centred in the window?
Skins: which glows evenly without a hot spot, and is it still bright enough?
fit.print: Print base down, no supports, in the enclosure's material (white or natural for the skins).
